name: SK Notice Hider
author: Samarjit Kashyp

sections.description:
SK Notice Hider is a professional WordPress plugin that allows you to control and manage various types of notifications in your WordPress dashboard. Clean up your admin area by hiding unnecessary notices and emails while preserving critical security alerts.

Why Use SK Notice Hider?

Problem: Your WordPress dashboard is cluttered with too many notifications, update notices, and promotional messages.

Solution: SK Notice Hider gives you complete control over WordPress notifications:
– Hide update notification emails
– Hide admin notices and warnings
– Hide plugin update notices
– Hide theme update notices
– Keep your dashboard clean and focused

Features

  • Notification Hiding Features:

    • Hide update notification emails for plugins, themes, and core
    • Hide admin notices and warnings from dashboard
    • Hide plugin update and activation notices
    • Hide theme update and activation notices
    • Preserve critical security and error notices

  • User Experience:

    • Easy-to-use settings interface with sidebar layout
    • Confirmation dialogs for critical actions
    • Visual feedback for active settings
    • Responsive design for all devices
    • Fully compatible with WordPress 5.8+
    • Translation ready

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports:

  1. WordPress.org Support Forum: Visit the plugin support page
  2. Email Support: jitsamar541@gmail.com
  3. Documentation: Complete documentation available on plugin website

Contributing

We welcome contributions! Here’s how you can help:

  1. Report Bugs: Use the issue tracker on GitHub
  2. Suggest Features: Submit feature requests
  3. Translate: Help translate the plugin to your language
  4. Spread the Word: Review the plugin on WordPress.org

Development

  • Main Developer: Samarjit Kashyap
  • License: GPL v2 or later
  • Minimum PHP: 7.4
  • Minimum WordPress: 5.8
  • Tested up to: WordPress 6.9

Credits

  • Developer: Samarjit Kashyap
  • Contributors: Open source community
  • Testers: Beta testing volunteers
  • Translators: International translation team
  • WordPress Community: For continuous inspiration and support

License

SK Notice Hider is released under the GPL v2 or later license. This means you can use, modify, and distribute the plugin freely as long as you follow the GPL license terms.

Privacy

SK Notice Hider does not:
* Collect any personal user data
* Send data to external servers
* Track user activity
* Store any analytics

The plugin only stores your settings in your WordPress database and does not communicate with any external services.

Compatibility

  • WordPress: 5.8 to 6.9+
  • PHP: 7.4 to 8.3+
  • Browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge (latest versions)
  • Themes: All WordPress themes
  • Plugins: Compatible with most WordPress plugins
  • Multisite: Fully supported
  • WooCommerce: Compatible
  • Page Builders: Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, etc.

Donate

If you find this plugin useful, consider donating to support continued development:

  • Donate via PayPal: https://samarjitkashyps.com/donate
  • Buy me a coffee: Support on Ko-fi

Your support helps maintain and improve SK Notice Hider for everyone!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sk-notice-hider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > SK Notice Hider to configure the plugin
  4. Select notification types you want to hide
  5. Save your changes and enjoy a cleaner dashboard
sections.faq:
Will this hide critical security notices?

No, the plugin is designed to preserve critical security and error notices to ensure your site remains secure. Security-related notices will always be visible.

Can I still update plugins and themes when notices are hidden?

Yes, the plugin only hides the visual notices. You can still update plugins and themes through the updates page. The update functionality remains fully intact.

Will I receive email notifications for failed updates?

If you enable “Hide Update Emails”, you will not receive any update notification emails, including for failed updates. You should monitor your site through other means.
